nearest_text_before.text: Если у вас есть хронические заболевания, например диабет, заболевания щитовидной железы или гипертония, то это нужно обсудить с профильным специалистом. Он подберет безопасное лечение, скорректирует лекарства и назначит нужные витамины.

nearest_text_after.text: Принимайте фолиевую кислоту и дополнительные витамины по назначению

inputs.user_direction: Background-patch experiment with no people in the source. The provider positive prompt must contain exactly the following quoted text and no other words: 'Locked camera. A slight, gradual shift in natural daylight is the only motion. Preserve the complete composition and all visible details.' Keep the negative prompt null.

image_reading: A softly focused white interior with a bookshelf or cabinet, several upright blue and dark books, and two clear glass bottles on the right.
No people are visible; the composition is static, bright, and dominated by pale neutral surfaces.
The soft focus limits detailed object animation, making a subtle illumination change the most suitable visible motion.
analysis.article_context: Body image in the section about medical consultations and examinations. Its calm, clinical bookshelf setting supports the practical advice to prepare a list of questions so nothing is missed during the appointment.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Support the article’s calm, organized approach to preparing for a medical consultation before pregnancy.
structured_intent.primary_action: Natural daylight gradually shifts across the existing scene.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The scene ends with a subtle, natural change in illumination across the same intact composition.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The quiet consultation-related setting, complete composition, and all visible details remain unchanged.

models.scene_plan: Over the four-second single shot, keep the camera locked while natural daylight shifts very slightly and gradually across the existing white surfaces, books, and glass bottles. The illumination change remains restrained and continuous, ending with a subtly changed but still natural light balance while the full composition and every visible detail remain unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: Locked camera. A slight, gradual shift in natural daylight is the only motion. Preserve the complete composition and all visible details.
